title: Nourishing Tender Brazilian Chicken Skewers
description: Tender and flavorful Brazilian chicken skewers featuring jalapeno, perfect for a post-workout meal, with a briny and slightly spicy taste, made with FODMAP-friendly ingredients
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut oil, lime juice, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Sprinkle the chopped jalapeno and parsley over the chicken
Cook the skewers in the air fryer for 12 minutes, shaking halfway through
Check the internal temperature of the chicken to ensure it reaches 165 degrees Fahrenheit
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired
